source: Binance public archive bucket listing data/futures/um/monthly/klines/ (1h files) + the 1h blocks
notes: listed = first hour with trades when the archive's first 1h month is inside the built window, else the start of that first month (the 1h archive starts 2020-01: earlier listings count there)
delisted = no trades in the last 3 days of the stored data (the archive keeps publishing flat files after a delisting, so the last file month is not used)
kind settled = an archive copy of a contract settled while its name was reused (same history as the original symbol); delivery = dated quarterly contract; neither enters a universe
